ui.kitIntro: Every clinic gets the same models. That is what makes openings fast and support easy.

templateIntro.simple: Every clinic's network is created from the same template. Only the site number changes.
templateIntro.technical: The firewall configuration is rendered from one template; site id, code and number are the only variables.

ui.diffSummary: {count} of {total} lines differ, all because of the site variables.
ui.dashIntro: A generic view of a cloud-managed firewall fleet. It shows the network as the failure simulator sees it right now.
ui.notApplied: München is not in the dashboard yet.
ui.applied: Template applied: München is staged with site number 3.
ui.observe: Pilot healthy. Observe for {hours} hours (illustrative) before the other clinics.
ui.ansibleIntro: One playbook pushes VLANs, SNMP, NTP and syslog to every clinic switch. Run it twice and nothing changes the second time.
ui.unreachable: {host} is unreachable: it is off or cut off in the failure simulator. Fix that, then run again with --limit {host}.
ui.compareTitle: Opening a clinic without and with standards

reason.spares: One spare per model at HQ replaces any failed device in any clinic.
reason.behaviour: Known behaviour: a bug or a quirk is found once, not in every clinic.
reason.config: One configuration template instead of a special setup per clinic.
reason.support: Support, documentation and training are the same everywhere.

auth.reason: {host} failed: authentication failed, the local admin password was changed by hand.
auth.fix: Restore the managed credential from the vault, run again with --limit {host}, and find out who changed it outside the template.

order.title: Order
order.text: Bought through the business channel, so the serial number is registered to the company.

assign.title: Assign
assign.text: The serial number is assigned to the MDM automatically.

unbox.title: Unbox
unbox.text: The employee switches it on and joins the Wi-Fi or a cable.

profiles.title: Configure
profiles.text: The MDM pushes Wi-Fi, apps, disk encryption and security settings.

login.title: Log in
login.text: The employee logs in and starts working. No IT visit needed.
